mapper.sql: select u.id, u.email, u.password_hash, u.status, u.lock_reason, u.failed_login_count, u.last_login_at, u.password_changed_at, u.password_change_required, r.is_super from bo_user u join bo_role r on r.code = u.role_code
mapper.update: update bo_user set failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update bo_user set failed_login_count = 0, last_login_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update bo_user set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = now(), password_change_required = false, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select rm.menu_code || ':' || a.action from bo_user u join bo_role_menu rm on rm.role_code = u.role_code join bo_menu m on m.code = rm.menu_code cross join lateral (values ('C', rm.can_create and m.use_create), ('R', rm.can_read and m.use_read), ('U', rm.can_update and m.use_update), ('D', rm.can_delete and m.use_delete)) as a(action, granted) where u.id = #{id} and a.granted and (m.exclusive_role_code is null or m.exclusive_role_code = u.role_code)

select m.code, m.parent_code, g.name as group_name, m.name, m.path, m.icon, m.use_create and (r.is_super or coalesce(rm.can_create, false)) as can_create, m.use_read and (r.is_super or coalesce(rm.can_read, false)) as can_read, m.use_update and (r.is_super or coalesce(rm.can_update, false)) as can_update, m.use_delete and (r.is_super or coalesce(rm.can_delete, false)) as can_delete from bo_user u join bo_role r on r.code = u.role_code join bo_menu m on m.parent_code is not null and m.visible join bo_menu g on g.code = m.parent_code left join bo_role_menu rm on rm.role_code = u.role_code and rm.menu_code = m.code where u.id = #{id} and (r.is_super or (m.use_read and coalesce(rm.can_read, false))) and (r.is_super or m.exclusive_role_code is null or m.exclusive_role_code = u.role_code) order by g.sort_order, m.sort_order

select u.id, u.email, u.name, u.department, u.role_code, r.name as role_name, r.is_super, u.password_change_required, u.avatar_updated_at from bo_user u join bo_role r on r.code = u.role_code where u.id = #{id}
